visual_elements.description: Top confusion matrix. Title 'Predicted as' above. 2x2 table with column headers P, N; row headers P, N. Row label 'Actual' rotated vertically on left. Cells: row P: TP (green highlight), FN (white); row N: FP (white), TN (green highlight). Table border blue. Text black except 'Actual' red.

Bottom confusion matrix. Title 'Predicted as' above. 2x2 table with column headers P, N; row headers P, N. Row label 'Actual' rotated vertically on left. Cells: row P: 28 (blue circle/oval), 2 (red circle/oval); row N: 30 (white), 40 (green highlight). Table border blue. Text black except 'Actual' red.

Tree diagram in red-bordered box. Headings 'Positive' (red) and 'Negative' (green). Below each heading a gray line-drawing airplane icon. Positive root node 30 (dark red circle) branches to 28 (dark red circle) labeled TP (red) and 2 (green circle) labeled FN (green). Negative root node 70 (green circle) branches to 40 (green circle) labeled TN (green) and 30 (dark red circle) labeled FP (red). Branches are blue arrows.

Gray fraction box: numerator 'Correctly Classified (as Positive)', denominator 'Total objects that should be retrieved (Actually Positive)', separated by red horizontal line. Gray background, black text.
Pale yellow meaning box: 'Meaning' in red, 'Does the classifier miss any of Positive Objects ?' with 'miss' italic and 'Positive' blue. Black text otherwise.
Red rounded rectangle formula box: 'Recall =' and fraction TP over TP + FN. Black text, red border.
Light blue calculation box: 'Recall= 28/(28+2)' and '=93.3%'. Black text, light blue background.

Two small beige boxes: left 'Positive Classified as +ive', right 'Positive Classified as -ive'. Black text, beige background. Small arrows point from boxes toward formula denominator. Green curly brace below spanning both boxes with text 'All Positive Samples in the Dataset' in green.

Blue-bordered box with italic text: 'Higher Recall means I HIGHLY trust you if you said i picked ALL Positive Objects.' and 'It Does NOT mean All you said Positive are Actually Positive'. Black text, blue border.
Slide number '11' in yellow circle at top right.
